definitions.gloss: with a piercing glare, with a sharp look
definitions.explanation: Describes the action of looking at someone with a sharp, intimidating, or disapproving gaze. A single, deliberate stare rather than repeated glancing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ジロリ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}られた→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher gave me a sharp look.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}して→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ジロリ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: When I entered the classroom late, the teacher glared at me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大声|おおごえ}→大声：09592_oogoe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}していたら→話す：00467_hanasu⟧、⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ジロリ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧にらまれた。
examples.english: When I was talking loudly on the train, the person next to me shot me a piercing glare.

notes:
RELATED WORDS:
ジロリ describes a single sharp glare. The repeated form ジロジロ describes staring persistently or rudely — looking someone up and down. ジロリ is a momentary piercing look; ジロジロ is prolonged and impolite staring.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: ジロリ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to glare at), ジロリ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧にらむ (to stare menacingly).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ジロリ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to give a sharp look
- ジロリ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧にらむ: to glare menacingly
- ジロリ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{睨|にら}みつける→睨みつける：13683_niramitsukeru⟧: to fix with a piercing stare
